text:
Rachel: quick thought — can we prototype a tiny preflight hook interface for deploy-bot? something opinionated: run 2-3 smoke checks + a perf sample, then auto-generate a release-note snippet. low friction UX: /deploy preview --hooks=smoke,kv-check --notes-generate
Sam: love this. want a flag that spits out the notes template so PMs can edit before ship. maybe --notes-draft or --notes-to-clipboard
Maria: also we should enforce change-window checks during preview if target is production. preview should surface a WARNING, not block, unless you run with --enforce-window
Jonathan: sketching a proposal — slash usage + small hook config. example:
```
/deploy preview --service=frontend --ref=canary --hooks=smoke,api-contract --pin=frontend@v2.3 --notes-template=short

# hooks.yml (defaults)
hooks:
  smoke:
    cmd: ./ci/run_smoke.sh --fast
    timeout: 30s
  api-contract:
    cmd: ./ci/contract_check.sh --against=prod
    timeout: 60s
```
Jonathan: output from preview would be: hook results, perf sample (p50/p95), list of changed components, and a ready-to-insert notes stanza. nothing auto-published
Teja: add a guard for pin behaviour: preview should NOT mutate pins. require explicit --apply-pin to actually change pin. and an override `--force-pin` for emergency rollbacks with a confirmation flow
Sam: minor UX idea — `--notes-template=compact|verbose` and `--notes-vars=author,incidents` so the bot can fill a template like: "changelist: ..., impact: low, rollback: none"
deploy-bot: heads-up — I can implement a lightweight preview mode that runs configured hooks in a sandbox and uploads results as a blob. usage suggestion:
```
/deploy preview --service=<svc> --ref=<ref> --hooks=hook1,hook2 --notes-template=compact
# returns: preview_id=pv_20240316_42, url=https://deploy/reports/pv_...
```
ci-bot: smoke check passed (3/3), contract check failed on the `/users` schema change. @Jonathan can you take a look? :warning:
Rachel: good catch. the preview report URL would let PMs and eng link to the exact failure and the auto-generated notes will include that as a known issue section
Maria: one more constraint — when change window is closed and target is prod, include a prominent "cannot apply pins during closed window" line unless --enforce-window omitted. avoids accidental late-night pins
Sam: i'll volunteer to put together a tiny PR for the deploy-bot CLI and a template library. will stub the notes templates and the hook runner. linking a draft branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy-bot/pull/321 (WIP)
Jonathan: for rollout safety, preview should also show which model quantization/profile gets used (helpful for perf regressions) and recommend a quantized fallback if perf > threshold
Teja: yes, and add a quick `--abort-on-failure` vs `--continue-on-failure` flag for composite hooks. defaults to abort
Rachel: next steps: Sam + Jonathan + Teja to collaborate on 1) hooks.yml defaults 2) notes templates 3) change-window & pin semantics. I'll create a short RFC doc and drop it in #eng-releases/rfcs
Sam: acked. timeline — aim for a small beta by next week, opt-in behind feature flag for dedicated teams
Rachel: thanks all. this should cut down the "what did you run before you rolled" follow-ups. :seedling:
